                Motion for a resolution                               Amendment

                                                       1a.      Expresses grave concern
                                                       regarding the blockade and
                                                       instrumentalisation of humanitarian aid
                                                       by state and non-state actors for purposes
                                                       of forced displacement and ethnic
                                                       cleansing, in violation of international
                                                       humanitarian law and international
                                                       human rights law; stresses that such
                                                       practices deprive the population in the
                                                       affected territories of goods indispensable
                                                       to their survival and constitute serious
                                                       violations of the Geneva Conventions;
                                                       calls, therefore, for the EU and its
                                                       Member States to adopt duly justified
                                                       sanctions against non-EU countries and
                                                       individuals responsible for these
                                                       violations;

                                                       1b.     Recalls that UN agencies and
                                                       other international organisations
                                                       providing humanitarian relief in an
                                                       occupied territory cannot be unilaterally
                                                       excluded or obstructed by the occupying

                                                       including EU Member States, are under
                                                       an obligation, pursuant to the UN
                                                       Charter, to give the UN agencies and
                                                       other international organisations every
                                                       assistance in the humanitarian action
                                                       they undertake, as recently confirmed by
                                                       the International Court of Justice in its
                                                       advisory opinion of 22 October 2025;

                                                       measures of the International Court of
                                                       Justice ;

     Paragraph 4 a (new)

                Motion for a resolution                                Amendment

                                                       4a.      Underlines that where the EU
                                                       funds and delivers humanitarian aid
                                                       intended to save lives and prevent famine,
                                                       and a non-EU country obstructs or blocks
                                                       its delivery, the EU must use all political,
                                                       diplomatic, legal and economic leverage
                                                       at its disposal to secure the immediate and
                                                       unhindered passage of that aid and
                                                       ensure that it reaches the population in
                                                       need; calls on the Commission and the
                                                       EEAS to systematically raise such
                                                       obstruction at the highest political level
                                                       and to take all measures needed against
                                                       states, entities or individuals responsible
                                                       for the obstruction, in order to achieve the
                                                       immediate and unimpeded delivery of
                                                       humanitarian assistance;
